mail/imap_reading#

Reading one IMAP response from a stream, literals included, keeping the bytes read past it.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let read = await ImapResponseReading(socket).read();
read.response();
let next = await ImapResponseReading(origin: socket, prefix: read.remainder()).read();

Description#

Reading one IMAP response from a stream, literals included, keeping the bytes read past it.

Untagged and continuation responses come back at once. A read that fails part way may have consumed input: the session is then over.
